name: Azusawa Kohane
source:
Kohane is a bashful girl who lacks self confidence. But one day, she suddenly witnesses a jam session with [url=/c128184]An[/url] and her fellow musicians at a live performance cafe and bar lining the street. She found herself being bombarded with - and captivated by - the rap rhythm and intense tempo of their music that she never heard before.

She's part of the street music group Vivid BAD SQUAD.

[From in-game profile]
